title: The Lattice Mirror
mathematical_role: Render the exact six-set family as a finite join-semilattice under inclusion with join A∨B=A∪B.
learning_objective: See concretely how union becomes join and identify the join-irreducible elements in one finite example without collapsing set-family and lattice theorem statements.
literal_semantics: The vertices are exactly the six members of F ordered by inclusion.
Join is union for the displayed family.
{a}, {b}, and {a,c} are the non-bottom join-irreducibles of this finite example.
nonliteral_semantics: Vertical position indicates order only; distance and box shading do not encode algebraic magnitude.

notes: Exact finite-example data are reproduced by tests/test_visual_pedagogy_batch1_candidates.py.
Imported theorem-terrain language remains bounded by the documentary source and does not admit a new external claim.

renderer.version_or_environment: Python 3 standard library; deterministic SVG generator v1
reproducibility_notes: The generator uses no network, randomness, timestamps, fonts embedded as files, or external data.
Repository tests compare generator output byte-for-byte with the committed SVG candidate.

accessibility.alt_text: Six-set join-semilattice under inclusion with join equal to union; {a}, {b}, and {a,c} are marked join-irreducible and two exact joins are written.
accessibility.long_description: The exact union-closed family is drawn as a finite poset. The bottom is the empty set and the top is {a,b,c}. Shaded nodes {a}, {b}, and {a,c} are the join-irreducibles in this example. Two joins are written explicitly to anchor the relation A∨B=A∪B.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: The displayed finite poset and join statements are exact for the stated family.
not_claimed: A general lattice-theoretic proof of Frankl's conjecture
Equivalence of every lattice formulation without its stated hypotheses
Any theorem about all join-irreducible counting regimes

supersession_reason: Replace cathedral-style lattice metaphor with a verified finite join-semilattice whose join operation and join-irreducibles are explicit.
